title: The Extend B2B - Companies and Users Management for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive…
description: The Extend B2B - Companies and Users Management for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress versions up to 2.1.4 suffers from a sensitive information exposure vulnerability via the register_company_api endpoint. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to access sensitive company-related data including user IDs, billing emails, credit balances and histories, purchase limits, spend totals, and shared-cart purchase order numbers.
